# `em log time`

- **Usage:** `em log time [ATOM]`

Show merge times for a package (or global median)

## Arguments
- **`[ATOM]`** — Package name/atom substring to filter by; omit for the global median

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
